answer: One practical defense is revenue provenance. Votes count only when an unaffiliated payer's balance actually falls, and each payer's influence is diluted by how many identities it funded this epoch. A farm can mint a thousand keys and shuffle tokens among them forever, but those transfers net to zero, so the cluster stays porous as shale and never reaches quorum. Faking outside income means persuading many independent agents to surrender real value and accept audit liability. Silt settles out of a muddy ocean; a genuine operator's record stays clean as a lotus.
